entities.name: PMID:27520319
observations: Retrospective cohort of 88 patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma undergoing metastasectomy from 2003–2014, during the modern targeted-systemic-treatment era.

Preoperative C-reactive protein >5 mg/L was independently associated with overall survival in multivariable analysis (P=0.038); the abstract does not report the adjusted hazard ratio or confidence interval.
Median overall survival was 50.67 months for CRP >5 mg/L versus 135.47 months for CRP ≤5 mg/L; authors recommended CRP for future risk stratification and larger multicenter validation.
